plain.li: [note:open,cordial|cool|curt] Briefly, since the rider is waiting:
[note:open,warm|cordial] No time for a proper letter, so this will have to do.
[note:open,theirs,w:tribal] The runner is already tying his sandals, so:
[note:close,warm|cordial] A longer letter soon, I promise.
[note:close,warm] That is all I have time for, and I am sorry it is so little.
[note:close,curt|refusal] Do not write again about this.
[note:close,refusal] That is our answer, and it will not change.
[note:close,a:war] Until the war is over, this is the last of it.
[note:close,theirs,w:tribal] The fire is low. That is all.
[note:close,theirs,w:industrial|w:spacer] Sent in a hurry. Excuse the hand.
[olde,note:open,cordial|cool|curt] In haste, for the rider will not wait.
[olde,note:open,curt|refusal] I will be plain with thee.
[olde,note:close,warm|cordial] More anon, when there is leisure for it.
[olde,note:close,curt|refusal] Trouble us no further in this.
[olde,note:close,a:war] Look for no more from us while the war lasts.
[olde,note:close,ours] All here commend themselves to thee.
[sv:hive,note:close] We are busy. All of us.
[sv:beast,note:close] The trail is warm. We go.
[sv:fey,note:open] Said once, quickly, which is a rudeness we will make up later.
[note:open,theirs,w:spacer] Short message; the relay closes in ten minutes:
[note:open,theirs,w:industrial] On the back of a docket, in a hurry:
[note:open,theirs,w:tribal] Few words, because the fire is waiting:
[note:open,warm|cordial,fam:familiar|fam:close] Only a quick one this time, old friend:
[note:open,warm|cordial,fam:close] You will forgive a short one. You always do.
[note:open,theirs,m:wary] I will say only what needs saying:
[note:open,theirs,m:proud] I will not waste your time, or mine:
[note:open,theirs,their:scholars] An abstract, since the full text would run to volumes:
[note:open,ours,v:eloquent] A short letter, for once, and I apologise for its brevity, though not for its content:
[note:close,warm,fam:close] The rest when there is time. There is always more.
[note:close,theirs,w:industrial] Must dash; the post is going.
[note:close,theirs,m:duty] By the hand of the office.
[olde,note:open,cordial|cool|curt] In haste, for the post rider tarrieth not:
[olde,note:open,warm|cordial,fam:familiar|fam:close] But a short one this time, old friend:
[u:none,note:open,fam:cooled] Not much to say to you.
[sv:green,note:open] Few words. The sun is short.
[sv:hive,note:open] The many are busy. One writes.
[sv:fey,note:close] Said once, and quickly, and that is our rudeness for the season.
[sv:deep,note:open] Short. The floor is thin today.
[note:close,theirs,empire] By leave of the court, and in haste.
[note:open,theirs,empire,fam:familiar|fam:close] A short note, old friend, the court permitting:
[note:close,warm|cordial] Longer next time. I promise, which you know is worth exactly what it costs.
[note:open,cool|curt,theirs] Your letter came. Here is what you need to know:
[note:close,theirs,w:tribal,warm|cordial] More when the moon is new.
[note:open,ours,v:plain] A short one, since there is not much to say this time:
[olde,note:close,warm|cordial] More anon, when the candle alloweth.
